content.title: Valspar Championship at Innisbrook Golf Resort
content.text: CONGRATULATIONS TO MATT FITZPATRICK, WINNER OF THE 2026 VALSPAR CHAMPIONSHIP! “I really like the golf course. The golf course is a great test. You’ve just got to look at the winning scores of the last however many years and it’s not super low, and I enjoy that when it’s a battle and you’ve gotta grind. It’s a great golf course and I enjoy being here.” Matt Fitzpatrick, 2026 Valspar Championship Winner Walk a mile (or 72-holes, to be exact) in the shoes of the world’s greatest golfers. You’ll quickly understand the special experience that is Copperhead: a spectacularly challenging course with incredible views and water features and of course, the famed Snake Pit finale. As the proud host of the PGA TOUR’s Valspar Championship, an official 72-hole event, Innisbrook supports the tournament's charitable efforts, which have raised over $51M for local organizations to date. Visit ValsparChampionship.com for more details. Play Before and After the Pros Experience first-hand what the world’s greatest golfers enjoy during championship week, from spectacular golf to incredible Salamander hospitality. Play a rotation of all the challenging courses, including the renowned Copperhead Course, and enjoy daily breakfast and lunch, pro shop credit, and more. It's your turn to take on the Snake Pit with our Platinum Golf Package. Buy Tickets Watch greatness unfold this March with the 2026 Valspar Championship. Learn about available tickets and parking options for attendees. Secure your spot now and begin your planning. Visit Tickets & Parking - Valspar Championship for more details. Savor the Full Experience Make your tournament days memorable with the perfect blend of unparalleled golf and culinary delights. Explore our dining options at Innisbrook Resort during the Valspar Championship: From the welcoming ambiance, variety in cuisine, live music, and course-side patios, our diverse offerings cater to every taste. Explore our dining options. Know Before You Go – The Players Get ready to meet golf's finest at the Valspar Championship. Dive into the excitement as players and past champions showcase their skills on the renowned Copperhead Course. Stay informed and make the most of your experience by exploring details about the event, players, and past champions. What Do The Pros Say? "I love this course. It's one of my favorite layouts and favorite tracks of the year." - Justin Thomas "It's a tougher golf course. I think it's one of those ones where you got to put it in the fairway. You got to be a good ball-striker around this place to play well. I think that's suiting me." - Brooks Koepka "It definitely fits my eye. It's kind of similar to courses that I grew up on, kind of through the trees. You got to work the golf ball both ways. You got to be in position off the tee, otherwise, you get blocked out on certain holes." - Adam Hadwin
